name: Barbell Hang Power Clean
steps: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip outside your thighs, then hinge at your hips with slight knee bend until the bar sits above your knees.
Extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively while shrugging upward to accelerate the bar close along your thighs.
Drop quickly into a quarter squat and whip your elbows forward to receive the bar across your front shoulders.
Stand tall to complete the lift, then lower the bar smoothly back to your thighs under control.
tips: Keep your chest over the bar in the hang position and finish extending your hips before bending your elbows.
Catch the bar with high elbows and a braced trunk rather than letting your upper back round forward.
